newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Perdigao 1996 net 19 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Perdigao 1996 net 19 mln reais.

text.p: Brazilian food processor Perdigao issued the following statement on its 1996 results adjusted for inflation.
NOTE: All figures in Brazilian reais.
Neither per share figures nor comparative numbers were provided.
The company said in a statement that 1996 results were hurt by an increase in grain prices and a fall in processed food prices in the domestic market due to excess supply.
Perdigao plans to invest 100 million reais this year to expand and modernize existing plants and complete the construction of its new plant in the southern state of Rio Grande do Sul.
Perdigao said it is Brazil's second largest meat processor with a 19.1 percent market share.
